hook: Hyderabadis lose *123 hours* a year in traffic. Evening 10 km takes 39 min
hook_b: Your evening commute: *15 km/h*. Hyderabad lost 123 hours to traffic last year
tldr: TomTom's 2025 index: Hyderabad commuters spent 123 hours stuck in traffic, evening rush crawls at 15.2 km/h, and 10 km takes 39 min 28 s. About 80 lakh vehicles are on the roads, double a decade ago.

beats.what: Hyderabad drivers lost 123 hours in 2025, 1 hour 16 minutes more than in 2024. Average congestion was 55.5%.
beats.why: Vehicles have roughly doubled in a decade to about 80 lakh. Evening peaks are worse than mornings: 85.7% congestion vs 66.4%.
beats.care: Leaving before the evening rush or taking the Metro on a 10 km trip can save you 5 minutes a day. That's about 20 hours a year.

cards.body: Worst day of 2025: Aug 30. Congestion hit 113% at 6 pm and you could cover just 3.3 km in 15 minutes. Indian metros typically average 25–30 km/h; Hyderabad's rush hour averages about 15–16 km/h and can drop to 10.
